summary_en: Link and Motivation will acquire SELF Inc., an enterprise AI service provider, through a simplified stock exchange effective October 1, 2026. The acquisition will be executed using Link and Motivation's treasury shares without issuance of new stock. SELF's SELFBOT service will be integrated into Link and Motivation's Motivation Cloud platform to enhance productivity and organizational transformation capabilities.
title_en: Notice Regarding Execution of Simplified Stock Exchange Agreement for Complete Acquisition of SELF Inc.
translation_en_brief:
Link and Motivation Inc. announced on September 9, 2026, the execution of a simplified stock exchange agreement to acquire SELF Inc. as a wholly owned subsidiary, effective October 1, 2026. SELF operates SELFBOT, an integrated AI service platform for enterprise customers that automates customer service, internal knowledge utilization, and support functions while maintaining large-enterprise-grade security standards. SELFBOT is currently deployed across numerous large enterprises and organizations.

Under the stock exchange, Link and Motivation will serve as the complete parent company and SELF as the complete subsidiary. The acquisition consideration will consist exclusively of Link and Motivation's ordinary shares from its treasury stock holdings, with no issuance of new shares and no cash or other consideration provided. All shareholders of SELF, including holders of ordinary shares and Series A preferred shares, will participate in the exchange. The transaction qualifies as a simplified stock exchange under the Company Law, requiring no shareholder approval at Link and Motivation; SELF shareholders will provide consent via written resolution.

Link and Motivation stated that integrating SELFBOT into its Motivation Cloud platform will enhance productivity support and organizational transformation outcomes by combining it with the company's existing cloud and consulting services. The acquisition is expected to expand cross-selling opportunities to customers seeking organizational change solutions and strengthen SELF's financial foundation through Link and Motivation's backing, supporting the parent company's mid-term growth strategy targeting 15 billion yen in operating profit and 24 billion yen in annual recurring revenue by 2030.
